headerDisplay: Focused Enphase IQ EV charger plugin with homeowner login, charger autodiscovery, Apple Home switch control, optional charging-status and estimated-power sensors, and adaptive polling.

gatewayTlsCa.title: Trusted Gateway Certificate (optional)
gatewayTlsCa.description: PEM certificate or CA for verifying the local gateway. The gateway hostname must match its certificate.

envoyToken.title: Envoy Local API Token (optional)
envoyToken.description: Bearer token for local Envoy/IQ Gateway API calls. Required by many firmware versions for Utility Power local polling.

exposeChargingPowerSensor.title: Expose Estimated Charging Power Sensor (Light Level)

enableUtilityPowerSensor.title: Expose Utility Power Sensor
enableUtilityPowerSensor.description: Adds a read-only Contact Sensor named Utility Power using the local Envoy/IQ Gateway. Closed/contact detected means utility grid power is available; open/contact not detected means outage or islanded.

utilityPowerDebounceSeconds.title: Utility Power Debounce (seconds)
utilityPowerDebounceSeconds.description: Grid state must remain changed for this long before HomeKit is updated.

utilityPowerPollIntervalSeconds.title: Utility Power Poll Interval (seconds)
utilityPowerPollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the local Envoy/IQ Gateway for utility grid state when the Utility Power sensor is enabled.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Legacy Poll Interval / Charging Poll Interval (seconds)
